caveat: When operated in FIPS mode and installed, initialized and configured as specified in the Security Policy Section 3 Secure Operation
description: The Check Point Cryptographic Library is a firmware module that provides cryptographic services to Check Point products. The module provides a number of NIST validated cryptographic algorithms for services such as IPSec and TLS. The module provides applications with a library interface that enables them to access the various cryptographic algorithm functions supplied by the module.
